acceptedAnswer.text: It uses gentle, rhythmic techniques to support the movement of lymph fluid, which carries waste and supports immune function. It can help with puffiness, swelling, and recovery. Here it is used for a clinical reason inside your plan, not as a stand-alone spa service.
For most people it is gentle and well tolerated. Certain conditions should be screened for first, which is why care here begins with a consult so it is used appropriately and for the right reason.

mainEntity.name: What is lymphatic drainage good for?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is commonly used to support swelling and puffiness, post-procedure recovery, and a feeling of lightness and sluggishness, as part of a broader plan. We use it when it fits your goals, not as a routine add-on.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions do I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what we are supporting. Some goals call for a short series, others for occasional sessions. Inside the membership plan you use it as your plan calls for, instead of paying per session.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a spa drainage session?

acceptedAnswer.text: Here drainage is used for a clinical purpose inside a plan directed by a physician who is also treating the root cause of the congestion.

mainEntity.name: Can I just book a session without becoming a patient?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drainage here is always part of physician-led care. You start with a $99 Symptom Consultation so it is used for the right reason and fits your plan.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: Lymphatic drainage in Atlanta that moves the puffiness and helps you heal faster.

paragraphs: If you carry puffiness, sluggishness, or post-surgery swelling and keep being offered a relaxing “drainage” session, the technique can genuinely help. The waste is doing it with no clinical reason and no plan around it.

I am Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD. Here lymphatic drainage is used for a clinical reason inside a plan that addresses why your system is congested in the first place. That is how an hour of bodywork turns into real, lasting relief.

sections.label: What it is

headings.text: Helping your lymph move, so swelling, recovery, and sluggishness ease.

paragraphs: Lymphatic drainage uses gentle, rhythmic techniques to support the flow of lymph fluid, which carries waste and supports immune function. Done for the right reason it genuinely helps with swelling, recovery, and sluggishness, especially when it is paired with a plan that treats the cause of the congestion.
Gentle techniques encourage lymph to move, helping with puffiness, swelling, and sluggishness.
It is often used to support recovery, post-procedure swelling, and a feeling of lightness.
We use it when it fits your plan and goals, so each session does real work.

sections.label: Who it's for

headings.text: Lymphatic drainage is right for some people. It is wrong for others.

eyebrowSpans: It is not for you if
paragraphs: If that second list stung a little, good. That honesty is exactly what you are paying for here.

boldPairs.body: You have swelling, puffiness, or sluggishness with a cause worth addressing
You are recovering from a procedure and want supported, gentle drainage
You want it used for a clinical reason inside a real plan that does real work

boldPairs.title: It is not for you if

boldPairs.body: You want a relaxing add-on with no interest in why you are congested
You are hoping a session alone will detox or fix a deeper issue
You expect it to replace a real workup or the rest of your plan

sections.label: Not a spa add-on

headings.text: Every spa offers lymphatic drainage now. This is not that.

paragraphs: At a spa, drainage is sold as an hour of pampering you hope does something. No reason, no plan, no one asking why you are congested. Here, lymphatic drainage is used for a clinical reason inside a plan that addresses the cause behind the swelling or sluggishness.

boldPairs.title: Used for a reason, not a treat
boldPairs.body: We use drainage when it fits your goals and plan, so the session actually counts.

boldPairs.title: One tool in a plan, not the answer
boldPairs.body: The session supports the work; the plan around it is what actually moves your health.

boldPairs.title: Clinically directed, not an upsell
boldPairs.body: Guided by a plan from a physician who knows your whole history.
